components.css: .ds-product-spec{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);font:450 15px/1.85 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-product-spec caption{text-align:left;padding-bottom:18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.ds-product-spec th,.ds-product-spec td{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px 20px;vertical-align:top}.ds-product-spec th{font-weight:650;width:30%;padding-left:0}

narrative.overview: A spacious industrial showroom with technical white and cool grey surfaces, navy typography, fine rules, and the confirmed rose brand accent. The system uses clear typographic hierarchy and open, ruled layouts to make technical information approachable.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet surfaces and generous section spacing.
Manrope throughout, with compact technical labels.
Rose actions, visible keyboard focus, and precise separators.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Use rose to identify action and emphasis; retain white and grey as the dominant surfaces.

dos: Do preserve the confirmed brand rose and locally hosted typeface.
Do retain keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Do not substitute blue reference accents for brand rose.
Do not turn technical information into nested elevated cards.
